_comment: WORKSHOPS PAGE COPY (English). REPOSITIONING (2026-09-16): Taqathon 2026's hackathon was postponed and this page — file/URL still named 'schedule' to avoid an unnecessary URL change, same reasoning as every other migration in this project — was renamed 'Workshops' and made the primary destination for the new remote-workshop-series direction. 'intro' is adapted from the association's own official description of the series (three interconnected areas, applied/interactive focus). The 3 real workshops below are the exact lineup the user supplied directly (2026-09-16): dates were originally day/month only; the user confirmed the year is 2026 (2026-09-16 follow-up), so it's now included below rather than flagged as missing. Exact start times are still unconfirmed — each workshop's 'time' field is the user's own explicit placeholder text ('To Be Announced' / 'سيُعلن لاحقًا'), not a guess. 'topics' and 'moderator' are kept per workshop but deliberately NOT rendered by schedule.njk anymore (2026-09-16 public-vs-internal pass — the user clarified that level of detail was internal working context, not public copy); left in the data rather than deleted so a future round can restore them without re-typing. The old hackathon-phase 'keyDates' timeline (registration/screening/mentorship/winners) no longer reflects the current plan and is NOT rendered anymore either (see schedule.njk), same 'kept, not deleted' treatment. 'meetingHref'/'formHref' (2026-09-16 follow-up request) are placeholder '#' values — no real Google Meet or Google Form links exist yet — schedule.njk renders a disabled pending button for either field left as '#', the exact same pattern registration.njk already uses for its own not-yet-real links; swap in a real URL and it becomes a live button automatically, no template change needed.
